_comment: M50: the long-press quick reactions. rule: `chosen` is UserMe.quick_reactions (null = not set). Set: exactly the chosen ones in their order (the desktop hover bar takes the first `count`). Null: the ones I used last (`recent`, newest first, custom `:name:` skipped), then the defaults, without repeats, `count` of them. valid / invalid: what PATCH /users/me accepts as one item of quick_reactions (1-6 distinct items, else 422 validation_error): a plain Unicode emoji of at most 16 characters (no ASCII, whitespace, letters or digits), or since 2026-10-13 a custom emoji's `:name:` (name ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_+-]{1,31}$, EMOJI.md); a chosen custom emoji the client does not know (deleted) is skipped where the quick reactions are shown.

rule.name: not set, nothing recent: the defaults
not set: recent first, then defaults without repeats
not set: custom emoji stay in the picker
set: exactly the chosen ones, in order
set: the hover bar's three are the first chosen
set to an empty list (never sent by the server): as not set
set: a custom emoji is kept in its place
